description.summary: the keyboard layout group of a seat's keyboard

protocol.description:
The names of a seat's layouts, the active layout group of its keyboard, and the request that changes it, for the shell's input-source switch. wl_keyboard.keymap cannot name them: it goes to every wl_keyboard, unfocused ones included, each time a virtual keyboard's own keymap takes the seat's place for its keys. The compositor offers the manager only to the clients it trusts with it; it is Athanor's own protocol (doc_own_stack.md OS5, decision 19).
A new version adds interfaces, requests, events or enum entries; a client binds the version it knows.

interface.name: athanor_keyboard_group_manager_v1
interface.description: Makes the keyboard group object of a wl_keyboard.

entry.name: already_made
entry.summary: the client already has a keyboard group object of this keyboard

request.name: destroy
request.description: The keyboard group objects made from the manager stay valid.

request.name: get_keyboard_group

description.summary: the keyboard group of a keyboard

request.description:
Makes the keyboard group object of a wl_keyboard. The seat's layouts and the current group are sent at once.
An object made for the keyboard of a seat the compositor does not drive is inert: it sends nothing and ignores its requests. A second keyboard group object of the same wl_keyboard, while the client holds the first, is the already_made error.

interface.name: athanor_keyboard_group_v1

description.summary: the layout group of a keyboard

interface.description: The active layout group of a keyboard, sent when the object is made and at each change, whether or not the client has the keyboard focus, a new keymap included.

event.name: group
event.description: The index of the active layout group among the seat's own layouts, whichever keymap wl_keyboard.keymap last sent.

event.name: layouts

description.summary: the names of the seat's layouts

event.description: The names of the seat's own layouts, in group order, each one ended by a newline, so that the lines are as many as the groups: a layout with no name is an empty line, and a newline or a carriage return inside a name is sent as a space. Sent when the object is made and each time the seat's configuration is applied, whether or not it changed them. A virtual keyboard's keymap changes neither the seat's layouts nor this list.

request.name: set_group
request.description: Makes group the active layout group. Every keyboard group object of the keyboard is then sent the group event, and the client with the keyboard focus wl_keyboard.modifiers with the new group. A group at or beyond the number of groups of the keymap is ignored.
